game.start: Welcome to Nowruz in Shiraz! Tap the four spring lanterns to light the courtyard.
game.praise: Warm golden light! Now Shiraz is ready for Master Hakim's wonder!

game.start: Firuz turns the golden sun peg! Tap when the ring glows green to spin the gears!
game.praise: Three bright turns! Hold on tight, Prince Firuz, up into the sky!

game.start: Puffy clouds hide the horse's shoulder! Tap the three white clouds to clear the view.
game.praise: All clear! Look, there shines the cool silver moon peg beside the sun peg!

game.start: Light the sky path! Tap the four twilight stars in order, from left to right.
game.praise: Twinkle, shine! The star path leads straight to the glowing marble tower!

game.start: It is dark on the rooftop! Tap the four brass star-lanterns to light the garden.
game.praise: Warm starlight glows all around! Now Yasmin can see the Ebony Horse clearly.

game.start: Help Yasmin and Firuz mend the horse! Tap each brass gear, then tap its matching pin.
game.praise: Snug and bright! Every golden gear spins smoothly inside the Ebony Horse!

game.start: Sight the Evening Star with Yasmin's astrolabe! Tap when the ring turns green!
game.praise: Locked on the Evening Star! Now glide smoothly beneath the grey wind-clouds!

game.start: Help King Sabur and Hakim guide Firuz home! Tap all five brass braziers to light them.
game.praise: Five bright golden beacons shine high into the night sky above Shiraz!

game.start: Guide the Ebony Horse down! Tap the three glowing courtyard stones in order to land.
game.praise: Soft and steady! Welcome home to Shiraz, Firuz and Yasmin!

spreads.title: The Sun, Moon, and Star Compass

game.start: Finish the safe sky-saddle! Match the sun sign, moon sign, and star-compass to their places.
game.praise: Shining bright! Now every rider knows how to rise, steer, and land safely!
